title: Reject a reused idempotency key with a different request

facts.note: Role (PLT-84), mapped to paths by the structure profile.
The task uses client-supplied idempotency keys.
Observer: a mutating boundary handler or use case is added or changed.

fires: A client reuses a key with a different payload or target.

given: A mutating operation that stores outcomes by idempotency key
when: a stored key arrives with a request whose fingerprint differs from the stored one
then: Reject the request with a client error and perform no effect.
prefer: Fingerprint every field that changes the effect, including the target resource and the caller.
Return a distinct, documented error code for the mismatch.
avoid: Returning the stored outcome for a different request.
Executing the new request under the old key.
why: A reused key with a new payload is a client bug or an attack; either silent outcome hides it and corrupts the record.
evidence: A test reuses a key with a changed field and observes a client error and no effect.
